"""Command line: python -m inimerge FILE [FILE ...] prints the merged INI text."""

import sys

from inimerge.merge import merge_files, render


def main(argv: list[str]) -> int:
    """Merge the files named in argv, later files winning, and print the result."""
    if not argv:
        print("usage: python -m inimerge FILE [FILE ...]", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    sys.stdout.write(render(merge_files(argv)))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:]))
